messages.content: NOX is our headless CMS and backend-as-a-service platform, built on Azure with MongoDB. It powers products across the Innovation Family group.
Summarize what an attack surface scan does.

An attack surface scan discovers internet-facing assets belonging to an organization and checks them for exposed services, misconfigurations, and known vulnerabilities, producing a prioritized list of risks.
